label: POC Onboarding: Playbook
mcp_tool_description: Return the POC onboarding playbook text: the procedure an agent follows to take a fresh CloudBolt appliance through a proof of concept with these tools. Sections: index (the skill: hard rules and the phase loop), bootstrap, resource-handlers, phases, troubleshooting, test-plan-map. Call it first when you have no cb-poc-onboarding skill loaded and the user asks to onboard, set up or POC CloudBolt; follow the text it returns. The text is fetched from GitHub through the appliance's proxy settings; when that fails the response gives the URL to open in a browser. Read-only.
